name: Grassland
description: Lush, well-watered flatland. The best food per tile of any land terrain.

name: Plains
description: Open, workable land that trades a little food for useful production.

name: Desert
description: Barren sand. Yields nothing on its own, but hides oases and often sits on strategic resources.

name: Tundra
description: Cold, thin soil at the edge of the habitable world.

name: Snow
description: Permanent ice cap. Effectively worthless to work, but still claims territory.

name: Mountains
description: Impassable peaks. Cannot be worked or crossed, but grants Appeal and feeds Campus and Holy Site adjacency.

name: Coast
description: Shallow water within reach of land. Workable, and required for Harbours.

name: Ocean
description: Deep water. Impassable until the open sea is mastered.

name: Lake
description: Inland fresh water. Supplies Housing to any adjacent city.
